name: Magic Valley Equipment
old_description: Established 1985 in Paul Idaho. Magic Valley Equipment is known as one of the largest sugar beet equipment and parts dealers in the Western United States. Specializing in sugar beets, but also offering equipment and parts for many other agricultural needs such as; potatoes, hay, tillage, grain, planting and many more.  As a shortline dealer, we have access to many vendors and distributors.  If there is something you are in need of and we don't have it, generally we can find it.  We also have a full service shop for your repair or rebuild needs.
about:
Magic Valley Equipment was established in 1985 in Paul, Idaho. The company operates as a dealership for agricultural equipment and parts, with a focus on sugar beet machinery. No founders are named in the available records, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The business supplies equipment and parts for sugar beet, potato, hay, tillage, grain, and planting operations. As a shortline dealer, it maintains relationships with multiple vendors and distributors to source a broad range of products. The facility includes a full-service shop that handles repair and rebuild work for customer machinery.

Customers are primarily agricultural producers across the western United States, including sugar beet growers, potato farms, and operations focused on hay, grain, and tillage. The dealer serves both large-scale and smaller farming operations seeking replacement parts or new equipment.

The company emphasizes its ability to locate hard-to-find items through its vendor network, stating that if a part is not in stock it can generally be sourced. Its position as one of the largest sugar beet equipment dealers in the region reflects its long-standing presence in the market.
